brief.subject: Rope knot at the top of a rope column — the visible hanging point where a segment attaches to the support above
brief.gameplayMeaning: Knot texture for the 6x6x4 knot element at the top of each rope segment; the side faces show a 6px-wide x 4px-tall slice (uv rows 5-8, columns 5-10), the top face shows the full 6x6 center. Must read as a tied knot, not a solid brown bar
visualPriority: first read as a tied rope knot from the side
then show wrap/binding strokes so it is distinct from the plain rope body
share the rope palette so knot and body belong together

mustHave: knot bulge centered in columns 5-10, rows 5-10
dark binding/groove strokes across the bulge
light top highlight and dark bottom shadow for volume
mustNotHave: a plain solid rectangle without internal detail
